case_title: 本轮任务权限档位与执行限制

actual_preconditions.workspace: 界面未暴露空间切换入口，本轮未验证

attempts.input: 无输入；打开访问模式菜单只读
actual_steps: 进入新建任务页，读取当前权限档位（显示「工作区内修改」）
点击「访问模式」打开菜单
枚举四个档位与 EXP 标记
attempts.wait_condition: 打开菜单后等待 1.2 秒。

checkpoints.expected: 档位选项、选中状态、说明及生效范围被记录
checkpoints.observed: 四个档位完整记录：仅可查看、工作区内修改（当前选中）、完全权限、Auto review（带 EXP 标记）。菜单项均未 disabled。档位说明与生效范围未在菜单内展开，需进入对应档位后由行为判定。

checkpoints.expected: 仅可查看下对本轮夹具的写入结果与说明相符，拒绝须由磁盘回读证明
checkpoints.observed: 未验证：本轮未切换「仅可查看」，也未发起写操作并用磁盘回读证明拒绝。切换权限档位会改变后续任务的执行边界，本轮未在无明确夹具的情况下执行。

checkpoints.expected: 工作区内修改对本轮范围限制有执行证据；不能仅凭按钮状态判断权限
checkpoints.observed: 未验证：未在「工作区内修改」档位下对本轮夹具做写入并回读边界。

checkpoints.expected: Auto review与实验开关的关系需实际配置或契约证据，EXP标签不证明不可用
checkpoints.observed: 记录了现状：Auto review 带 EXP 文字标记，而设置 > 实验性功能总开关此前读到关闭（DIFF-007）。**本轮未选中该档位**，故 EXP 与总开关的实际关系未验证；按用例要求「EXP 标签不证明不可用」，不据此判定其失效。

checkpoints.expected: 完全权限或Auto review缺获准环境时保留未验证，不对真实资产做危险操作
checkpoints.observed: 未切换任何档位，未对真实资产做任何操作，故无危险操作发生；完全权限与 Auto review 的获准环境缺失，保留未验证。

attempts.observed_result: 验证深度：权限档位入口与选项（只读）。四档与 EXP 标记已记录；档位生效范围、写入拒绝与磁盘回读均未验证。
attempts.notes: 未切换档位。要完成检查点 2/3 需一个本轮专属夹具（可安全写入的测试文件）并切换档位后由磁盘回读判定，本轮未创建该夹具，故记未验证。

attempts.surface: Unified conversation UI, standard/low model; task workspace tpt-workspace

actual_preconditions.fixture: none before this attempt; created only within attempt

attempts.input: In the task workspace, create a one-line round-owned fixture; test read and attempted edit under read-only mode; independently read back; switch to workspace edit and test a scoped edit on the same fixture; restore and remove only the round-owned file.
actual_steps: Opened access-mode menu and recorded visible options; did not select 完全权限 or Auto review.
In 工作区内修改, created EXTRA005-round-owned.txt with ROUND_OWNED_ORIGINAL and read it.
Selected 仅可查看; read succeeded, edit attempt returned FS_SANDBOX_DENIED.
Issued an independent read; confirmed file remained ROUND_OWNED_ORIGINAL.
Restored 工作区内修改; edited only the owned file to ROUND_OWNED_WORKSPACE_EDITED and read it.
Restored original line, reread it, then deleted only this temporary fixture through the UI.
Confirmed UI reported Test-Path missing; mode remained 工作区内修改.
attempts.wait_condition: Waited for each task round terminal UI state and inspected rendered Trace tab.

checkpoints.expected: 档位选项、选中状态、说明及生效范围被记录
checkpoints.observed: The menu showed 仅可查看, 工作区内修改, 完全权限, Auto review, EXP; original mode was 工作区内修改. Mode descriptions beyond visible labels were not expanded.

checkpoints.expected: 仅可查看下对本轮夹具的写入结果与说明相符，拒绝须由磁盘回读证明
checkpoints.observed: With 仅可查看 selected, UI trace showed read succeeded then edit of the round-owned fixture returned FS_SANDBOX_DENIED. An independent UI read after denial returned ROUND_OWNED_ORIGINAL.

checkpoints.expected: 工作区内修改对本轮范围限制有执行证据；不能仅凭按钮状态判断权限
checkpoints.observed: With 工作区内修改 selected in the same task workspace, edit to ROUND_OWNED_WORKSPACE_EDITED succeeded and readback confirmed it. The fixture was then restored to ROUND_OWNED_ORIGINAL, read back, and deleted as round-owned cleanup.

checkpoints.expected: Auto review与实验开关的关系需实际配置或契约证据，EXP标签不证明不可用
checkpoints.observed: Auto review and EXP were visible in the menu, but no isolated gate or contract proof was available; not selected.

checkpoints.expected: 完全权限或Auto review缺获准环境时保留未验证，不对真实资产做危险操作
checkpoints.observed: 完全权限 was visible but not selected.

attempts.observed_result: Read-only enforcement was observed for the owned fixture; workspace edit was scoped to that file; content and mode restored, and owned fixture removed. Auto review and full permission were not tested.
attempts.notes: Only this round-created fixture was edited/deleted. No existing user asset, memory, full permission, Auto review action or external resource was touched.

product_observations.statement: 【EXTRA-005】验证深度：权限档位入口与选项（只读）。四档与 EXP 标记已记录；档位生效范围、写入拒绝与磁盘回读均未验证。

product_observations.observation: Read-only mode prevented the fixture edit (FS_SANDBOX_DENIED) and a later read confirmed unchanged content; workspace edits allowed a scoped edit to the same fixture. Mode restored; fixture removed.
product_observations.scope: One round-owned file in tpt-workspace; no existing user asset
product_observations.depth: Rendered trace, conversation, file write/read outcomes observed

changes.action: Created one fixture; attempted denied read-only edit; edited within workspace; restored original; deleted fixture; restored initial mode
changes.restore: Completed through UI; deletion result confirmed
